description: This file defines the ProductOptionValue entity class, representing a product option value in an e-commerce catalog. It includes properties such as ID, sort order, image, code, descriptions, and associations with merchant store. It leverages JPA annotations for ORM mapping, validation constraints, and Hibernate-specific indexing.

classes.name: ProductOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a product option value with properties for code, image, display settings, and related descriptions, linked to a merchant store, with ORM mappings and validation.
